variants.A0_qwen_unconstrained_raw: Qwen infers shape; no OpenCV shape is supplied in the prompt.
variants.A1_fixed_shape_prompt_raw: OpenCV shape is supplied; raw Qwen records are evaluated without repair.
variants.A2_fixed_shape_plus_validation_gate: A1 plus structural validation; invalid panels are routed to manual review.
variants.A3_full_structure_constrained: Fixed shape, validation, existing projection/normalization, and manual-review metadata.
